desc: Implement complete Python solution using direct enumeration of the smaller side (K or N-K) with itertools.combinations and total XOR for complements.
Add fast special cases: K == N (answer total_xor), K == 1 (answer max(A)), and N-K == 1 (answer max(total_xor ^ x for x in A)).
Ensure duplicates are handled correctly by enumerating positions/values via itertools.combinations rather than unique values.
Run the provided sample tests and verify outputs.
If direct enumeration fails or is too slow, switch to an optimized incremental enumeration or meet-in-the-middle approach.
